Bastion.desc: Increases all damage you deal by 10% while a shield is equipped.

Bloodthirst.desc: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 35% of your Attack Power plus 30 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec.

Bloodthrill.desc: Your Main Hand melee attacks against enemies afflicted by your Rend have a 20% chance to allow the use of your Overpower ability on the target. Lasts 6 sec.

Death Wish.desc: When activated, increases your Physical damage done by 20% and makes you immune to Fear effects, but increases all damage you take by 5%. Lasts 30 sec.

Flurry.desc: Increases your melee attack speed by 25% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

Improved Charge.desc: Increases the Rage generated by your Charge ability by 6.

Improved Shield Bash.desc: Gives your Shield Bash ability a 100% chance to Silence the target for 3 sec.

Improved Shield Wall.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Shield Wall ability by 11 min.

Improved Slam.desc: Reduces the global cooldown and cast time of your Slam ability by 0.5 sec. In addition, Slam no longer interrupts or delays your melee swing and Slam's cooldown is reduced by 3 sec.

Last Stand.desc: When activated, this ability temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum health for 20 sec. After the effect expires, the health is lost.

Master of Defense.desc: Grants you a 100% chance to generate 5 Rage when you Dodge or Parry while a shield is equipped.

Mortal Strike.desc: A vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 85 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.

Raging Blows.desc: Causes your Whirlwind to also strike with your Off Hand weapon, and reduces the Rage cost of your Cleave ability by 2.

Shield Slam.desc: Slam the target with your shield, causing 430 damage, increased by your Block Value, and has a 50% chance of dispelling 1 magic effect on the target. Causes a very high amount of threat.

Shield Specialization.desc: Increases your chance to Block attacks with your shield by 5% and grants you a 100% chance to generate 5 Rage when you Block.

Spearing Strike.desc: A brutal attack that deals 40% weapon damage, plus an additional 80% weapon damage against Giants, Dragonkin, and mounted targets.

Sweeping Strikes.desc: Your next 5 melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent.

Vanguard.desc: Your Charge ability is now usable while in Defensive Stance.

Weaponmaster.desc: Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon. Axe/Polearm: Increases your critical strike chance by 5%. Mace/Staff: Your attacks ignore 15% of your target's armor. Sword: Your successful melee attacks have a 5% chance to trigger an extra attack on the target.

Benediction.desc: Reduces the Mana cost of all instant cast spells and abilities by 10%.

Champion of the Light.desc: Increases your spell damage by up to 60% of your Intellect.

Divine Favor.desc: When activated, gives your next Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock spell a 100% critical effect chance.

Holy Conduit.desc: Reduces the mana cost of your Consecration, Holy Wrath, Exorcism, and Hammer of Wrath spells by 40%.

Holy Shield.desc: Increases chance to block by 30% for 10 sec, and deals 110 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active. Damage caused by Holy Shield causes 20% additional threat. Each block expends a charge. 4 charges.

Holy Shock.desc: Blasts the target with Holy energy, causing 134 Holy damage to an enemy, or 114 healing to an ally.

Illumination.desc: After getting a critical effect from your Flash of Light, Holy Light, Light's Vigil, or Holy Shock heal spell you have a 100% chance to gain Mana equal to 50% of the base cost of the spell.

Improved Righteous Fury.desc: While Righteous Fury is active, all damage taken is reduced by 6%.

Infusion of Light.desc: Your Holy Shock and Flash of Light critical hits reduce the cast time of your next Holy Light cast within 15 sec by 1 sec.

Instrument of Law.desc: Reduces the cast time of your Hammer of Wrath by 1 sec, and reduces all threat you generate by 20% while Righteous Fury is not active.

Iron Creed.desc: Increases the threat generated by your Holy Strike ability by 25%. While Righteous Fury is active, Holy Strike also reduces your damage taken by 10% for 6 sec.

Light's Vigil.desc: Applies Light's Vigil to the target for 30 sec. Your next Holy Shock cast on them triggers no cooldown and causes enemy targets to suffer 182 Holy damage and refund 75% of Light's Vigil's Mana cost, or allied targets to heal their party for 324. You may only have one Light's Vigil active per party.

Reckoning.desc: Gives you a 40% chance to gain an extra attack after Blocking a melee attack and a 100% chance to gain an extra attack after being the victim of a non-periodic critical strike.

Repentance.desc: Puts the enemy target in a state of meditation, incapacitating them for up to 6 sec. Any damage caused will awaken the target. Only works against Humanoids.

Reverence.desc: Allows 30% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Sacred Arbiter.desc: Increases the damage of your Holy Strike ability by 20% and causes it to refresh all Judgement effects on the target.

Seal of Command.desc: Gives the Paladin a chance to deal additional Holy damage equal to 70% of normal weapon damage. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Lasts 30 sec. Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing $/2;20467s1 Holy damage, 97 if the target is stunned or incapacitated.

Shield Specialization.desc: Increases the amount of damage absorbed by your shield by 30%, and gives your blocks a 100% chance to restore 6% of your maximum Mana. May only occur once every 3 sec.

Spiritual Focus.desc: Gives your Flash of Light, Holy Light, and Light's Vigil spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

Swift Judgement.desc: Finishes the remaining cooldown on your Judgement ability and reduces the Mana cost of your next Judgement by 100%.

Templar's Bulwark.desc: When activated, this ability grants you an absorb shield equal to 100% of your maximum health for 8 sec. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.

Twist of Light.desc: Reduces the Mana cost of your Seal spells by 20%, and when you replace your Seal of Command, Seal of Righteousness, Seal of Fury, or Seal of Justice with a different Seal, you gain an Echo of that Seal. Your next melee attack applies the replaced Seal's effects, consuming the Echo.

Voice of Truth.desc: Grants you immunity to Silence and Interrupt effects for 6 sec.

Bestial Discipline.desc: Increases the Focus regeneration of your pets by 20% and allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Bestial Wrath.desc: Send your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec. While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.

Careful Aim.desc: Increases your Attack Power by 100% of your Intellect.

Clever Traps.desc: Increases the duration of Freezing and Frost trap effects by 30% and the damage of Immolation and Explosive trap effects by 30%.

Counterattack.desc: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 50% weapon damage plus 26 and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

Deterrence.desc: When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec.

Expose Prey.desc: Your attacks against targets with Hunter's Mark have a 10% chance to activate your Mongoose Bite for 5 sec.

Ferocity.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of your pets and hawks by 10%.

Focused Fire.desc: Increases all damage you and your pet deal by 2% while your pet is active.

Frenzy.desc: Gives your pet a 100% chance to gain a 30% attack speed increase for 8 sec after dealing a critical strike.

Hawk Eye.desc: Increases the range of your ranged weapons by 6 yards.

Improved Arcane Shot.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Arcane Shot by 1.5 sec. Does not affect the cooldown of abilities which share a cooldown with Arcane Shot.

Intimidation.desc: Command your pet to Stun the target for 3 sec on its next successful attack, which also gains 100% increased critical strike chance. Generates high threat.

Lacerating Strikes.desc: Your Mongoose Bite also causes the target to Bleed for damage equal to 40% of the damage done by Mongoose Bite over 21 sec

Lone Wolf.desc: You deal 20% increased damage with all attacks while you do not have an active pet.

Mortal Shots.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus on all ranged abilities by 30%.

Predator's Edge.desc: Increases your melee critical strike damage by 30% and your Off Hand weapon damage by 50%.

Rapid Killing.desc: Reduces the cooldown on your Rapid Fire ability by 2 min. In addition, when you kill a non-trivial enemy or it dies while afflicted by your Serpent Sting, you gain Rapid Killing, increasing the damage of your next Shot ability within 20 sec by 20%.

Rapid Recuperation.desc: Hitting a target with your Serpent Sting ability grants you 50% and consuming Rapid Killing grants you 100% of your Mana regeneration while casting for the next 15 sec.

Resourcefulness.desc: Reduces the mana cost of your Trap abilities and melee abilities by 60%. In addition, your critical strikes have a 100% chance to allow 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting for 30 sec.

Scatter Shot.desc: A short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect. Turns off your attack when used.

Sniper Shot.desc: A long-range shot that deals ranged damage plus 160 and increases the range of your next 3 Shots by 10 yards for 10 sec.

Spirit Bond.desc: While your pet is active, you and your pet will regenerate 1% of total health every 5 sec.

Strider Kick.desc: A powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 sec.

Summon Hawk.desc: Command a hawk to dive-bomb your targeted enemy, dealing 32 Physical damage and continuing its assault for 18 sec. Only 2 hawks can be active at once. Summon Hawk shares its cooldown with Arcane Shot.

Survivalist's Discipline.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Trap and Deterrence abilities by 40%.

Trueshot Aura.desc: Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party members within 45 yards by 30. Lasts 30 min.

Adrenaline Rush.desc: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.

Blade Flurry.desc: Increases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec.

Cold Blood.desc: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%.

Cutthroat.desc: Your Backstab has a 15% chance to cause your next Ambush within 10 sec to not require Stealth.

Endurance.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Sprint and Evasion abilities by 60%.

Hack and Slash.desc: Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon. Axe/Sword: Your successful melee attacks have a 5% chance to trigger an extra attack on the target. Dagger/Fist: Increases your critical strike chance by 5%. Mace: Your attacks ignore 15% of your target's armor.

Hemorrhage.desc: An instant strike that deals 100% weapon damage (145% if a Dagger is equipped) and causes the target to take 15% increased Rupture damage from the Rogue. Lasts 15 sec. Awards 1 Combo Point.

Improved Kick.desc: Gives your Kick ability a 100% chance to Silence the target for 2 sec.

Improved Poisons.desc: Increases the chance to apply Poisons to your target by 10%, and gives Poison applications a 50% chance to not consume a charge.

Mutilate.desc: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 75% weapon damage plus an additional 13 with each weapon. Damage increased by 20% against Poisoned targets. Awards 2 Combo Points.

Premeditation.desc: Adds 2 Combo Points to your target. You must add to or use those combo points within 20 sec or the combo points are lost.

Preparation.desc: When activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your other Rogue abilities.

Relentless Strikes.desc: Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per Combo Point to restore 25 Energy.

Riposte.desc: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 150% weapon damage and disarms the target for 6 sec.

Seal Fate.desc: Your critical strikes from abilities that add Combo Points have a 100% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

Serrated Blades.desc: Causes your attacks to ignore 9% of your target's Armor and increases the damage dealt by your Rupture ability by 30%.

Thousand Cuts.desc: When your Rupture ability deals periodic damage, the Energy cost of your next Hemorrhage or Backstab ability within 10 sec is reduced by 3, stacking up to 5 times.

Venom.desc: Finishing move that increases the damage of your Poisons by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 10%. Lasts longer per combo point: 1 point : 9 sec 2 points: 12 sec 3 points: 15 sec 4 points: 18 sec 5 points: 21 sec

Weapon Expertise.desc: Reduces the chance for your attacks to be Dodged or Parried by 2%.

Binding Heal.desc: Heals a friendly target and the caster for 247. Low threat.

Devouring Contagion.desc: Reduces the mana cost of your Devouring Plague by 50%. Targets that die while Devouring Plague is active spreads it, jumping to a nearby enemy within 10 yds for the remaining duration.

Divine Aegis.desc: Your critical heals create a protective shield on the target, absorbing 15% of the amount healed. Lasts 12 sec.

Divine Fury.desc: Reduces the casting time of your Smite, Holy Fire, Heal, and Greater Heal spells by 0.5 sec.

Early Demise.desc: Increases Shadow Word: Death's critical strike chance on targets at or below 20% health by 30%.

Holy Nova.desc: Causes an explosion of holy light around the caster, causing 26 to 30 Holy damage to all enemy targets within 10 yards and healing all party members within 10 yards for 49 to 57. These effects cause no threat.

Inner Focus.desc: When activated, reduces the Mana cost of your next spell by 100% and increases its critical effect chance by 25% if it is a non-periodic spell and capable of a critical effect.

Litany of Light.desc: When you cast a healing spell, gain Mana equal to 10% of the base cost of the spell if your previous heal was a different spell.

Meditation.desc: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Mind Flay.desc: Assault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 63 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%.

Penance.desc: Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 81 Holy damage to an enemy, or 184 healing to an ally, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec.

Power Infusion.desc: Infuses the target with power, increasing their spell damage and healing done by 20% for 15 sec.

Power in Light.desc: Your Smite and Penance spells deal 10% increased damage to targets afflicted with your Holy Fire.

Prayer of Mending.desc: Places a spell on the target that heals them for 172 the next time they take damage or receive non-periodic healing. When the heal occurs, Prayer of Mending jumps to a party or raid member within 20 yards. Jumps up to 5 times and lasts 30 sec after each jump. This spell can only be placed on one target at a time per caster.

Renewed Hope.desc: Your heals from Flash Heal, Binding Heal, Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, and Penance gain 10% increased critical strike chance when cast on targets with Weakened Soul, and reduce the remaining duration of Weakened Soul on their target by 5 sec.

Shadow Weaving.desc: Your Shadow damage spells have a 100% chance to increase the Shadow damage you deal by 2% for 15 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

Shadowform.desc: Assume Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 10%, reducing the Mana cost of all Shadow spells by 50%, increasing the critical strike damage bonus of your Shadow spells by 100%, and reducing Physical damage taken by you by 15%. However, you may not cast healing spells while in this form.

Silence.desc: Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec and interrupting their spellcasts for 3 sec.

Soul Warding.desc: Reduces the cooldown on your Power Word: Shield spell by 4 sec and reduces its mana cost by 15%.

Spirit Tap.desc: Gives you a 100% chance to increase your Spirit by 100% for 15 sec after killing a non-trivial target or when an enemy afflicted by your Vampiric Embrace dies. For the duration, 50% of your Mana regeneration will continue while casting.

Spirit of Redemption.desc: Upon death, the priest becomes the Spirit of Redemption for 15 sec. The Spirit of Redemption cannot move, attack, be attacked or targeted by any spells or effects. While in this form the priest can cast any healing spell free of cost. When the effect ends, the priest dies.

Spiritual Guidance.desc: Increases your spell healing by up to 25% of your total Spirit and your spell damage by up to 8% of your total Spirit.

Twin Disciplines.desc: Increases the damage and healing of your instant cast spells by 5%.

Vampiric Embrace.desc: Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 20% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 30 sec.

Wand Specialization.desc: Increases your damage with Wands by 25%.

Earthbound.desc: Your Earthbind Totem Immobilizes nearby targets for 5 sec when cast.

Elemental Focus.desc: Gives you a 10% chance to enter a Clearcasting state after casting any Fire, Frost, or Nature damage spell. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.

Elemental Fury.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Searing and Magma Totems and your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by 100%.

Flurry.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

Healing Way.desc: Increases the amount healed by your Healing Wave spell by 25%.

Improved Ghost Wolf.desc: Reduces the cast time of your Ghost Wolf spell by 3 sec, and Ghost Wolf may be used indoors.

Improved Healing Wave.desc: Reduces the casting time of your Healing Wave spell by 0.5 sec.

Improved Stormstrike.desc: When you Stormstrike, you have a 100% chance to gain 50% mana regeneration while casting spells for 15 sec, and Stormstrike's cooldown has a 100% chance to reset each time you Dodge or Parry.

Lava Burst.desc: You hurl molten lava at the target, dealing 164 Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst deals 20% increased damage.

Lightning Overload.desc: Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a 10% chance to cast a second, similar spell on the same target at no additional cost that causes half damage and no threat.

Maelstrom Weapon.desc: When you deal damage with a melee attack, you have a chance to reduce the cast time and Mana cost of your next Lightning Bolt spell by 20%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.

Mana Tide Totem.desc: Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 12 sec that restores 88 mana every 3 seconds to group members within 30 yards.

Mental Dexterity.desc: Increases your Attack Power by an amount equal to 100% of your Intellect.

Nature's Swiftness.desc: When activated, your next Nature spell with a casting time less than 10 sec. becomes an instant cast spell.

Rage of the Farseer.desc: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 25 sec.

Restorative Totems.desc: Increases the effect of your Mana Spring Totem by 25% and increases the effect of your Healing Stream Totem by 50%.

Riptide.desc: Heals a friendly target for 485 to 533, an additional 445 over 15 sec, and increases the effectiveness of your Chain Heal casts directly on that target by 25%.

Spirit Weapons.desc: Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks, reduces all threat generated by your attacks by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is not active, and increases all threat generated by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is active.

Stormstrike.desc: Instantly strike for normal weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by 20% for 12 sec.

Tidal Mastery.desc: Increases the critical effect chance of your healing spells by 5%.

Water Shield.desc: The caster is surrounded by 3 globes of water. When a spell, melee, or ranged attack hits the caster or when one of the caster's healing spells gets a critical result, 2% of maximum mana is restored to the caster, expending one water globe. Only one globe will activate every few seconds. Lasts 10 min. Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at any one time.

Arcane Blast.desc: Blasts the target with energy, dealing 54 Arcane damage. Each time you cast Arcane Blast, the damage of all your other spells is increased by 10% and the mana cost of Arcane Blast is increased by 175%. Effect stacks up to 4 times and lasts 8 sec or until any other damage spell is cast.

Arcane Meditation.desc: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Arcane Mind.desc: Increases your Intellect by 10% and increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane spells by 100%.

Arcane Power.desc: For the next 15 sec, your spells deal 30% more damage while costing 30% more mana to cast.

Blast Wave.desc: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for 163 Fire damage, and Dazing them for 50% reduced movement speed for 6 sec.

Burning Soul.desc: Gives your Fire spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage and reduces the threat caused by your Fire spells by 30%.

Cold Snap.desc: Finishes the remaining cooldown on all your other Frost spells.

Combustion.desc: When activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by 10%. This effect lasts until you have caused 3 non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells.

Elemental Precision.desc: Improves your chance to hit with Frost and Fire spells by 5%.

Fingers of Frost.desc: Gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to grant you the Fingers of Frost effect, which treats your next 2 spells cast as if the target were Frozen. Lasts 15 sec.

Frostbite.desc: Gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to Freeze the target for 5 sec.

Heating Up.desc: Non-periodic critical strikes with Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast, and Scorch reduce the cast time of your next Pyroblast cast within 20 sec by 25%, stacking up to 3 times.

Ice Barrier.desc: Instantly shields you, absorbing 431 damage. Lasts 1 min. While the shield holds, your spellcasts will not be interrupted or delayed from taking damage.

Ice Block.desc: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.

Ice Lance.desc: Deals 28 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets.

Ice Shards.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Frost spells by 100%.

Ignite.desc: Your critical strikes from Fire damage spells cause the target to burn for an additional 40% of your spell's damage over 4 sec.

Improved Counterspell.desc: Your Counterspell also Silences the target for 4 sec.

Improved Scorch.desc: Your Scorch spell has a 100% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to Fire damage. This vulnerability increases all Fire damage you deal to your target by 3% and lasts 30 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

Master of Elements.desc: Your Fire and Frost critical strikes will refund 30% of their base mana cost.

Missile Barrage.desc: Gives your Arcane Blast spell a 40% chance, and your Fireball, Frostbolt, and Frostfire Bolt spells a 20% chance to reduce the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by 50%, reduce the Mana cost by 100%, and missiles fire every 0.5 sec.

Presence of Mind.desc: When activated, your next Mage spell with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes an instant cast spell.

Pyroblast.desc: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 101 to 131 Fire damage and an additional 44 Fire damage over 12 sec.

Shatter.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of all your spells against Frozen targets by 50%.

Wake of Fire.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Fire Blast spell by 2 sec. Killing a non-trivial target increases the critical strike chance of your next Fire Blast cast within 30 sec by 50%.

Amplify Curse.desc: Increases the effect of your next Curse of Weakness or Bane of Agony by 50%, or your next Curse of Exhaustion by 20%. Lasts 30 sec.

Bane.desc: Reduces the casting time of your Shadow Bolt, Immolate, and Incinerate spells by 0.5 sec and your Soul Fire spell by 2 sec.

Bane of Havoc.desc: Afflicts the target for 5 min, causing 15% of all damage done by the Warlock to other targets to also be dealt to the cursed target. Bane of Havoc is limited to 1 target, and only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

Conflagrate.desc: Ignites a target that is already afflicted by your Immolate spell, dealing 95 Fire damage and consuming your Immolate effect.

Decimation.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Soul Fire spell by 90%. When you cast Shadow Bolt or Searing Pain on an enemy below 35% health, they deal 6% increased damage, and for the next 10 sec your Soul Fire spell has its cast time reduced by 40% and costs no Soul Shards.

Demonic Knowledge.desc: Increases your spell damage and your Demon pet's spell damage by up to 100% of your level while you have a summoned Demon pet active.

Demonic Pact.desc: Your Demonic Sacrifice effect is no longer cancelled by summoning a different Demon pet. Resummoning the sacrificed pet will still cancel the effect.

Demonic Sacrifice.desc:
When activated, sacrifices your summoned Demon to enhance the opposing aspect of your power, granting you an effect that lasts 2 hrs. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned.

Imp: Increases your Shadow damage by 15%.

Voidwalker: Restores 2% of your total Mana every 4 sec.

Succubus/Incubus: Increases your Fire damage by 15%.

Felhunter: Restores 3% of your total Health every 4 sec.

Fel Domination.desc: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 5.5 sec and its Mana cost reduced by 50%.

Improved Corruption.desc: Reduces the casting time of your Corruption spell by 2 sec and increases the damage it deals by 10%.

Improved Shadow Bolt.desc: Your Shadow Bolt critical strikes increase Shadow damage taken by the target from your attacks by 20% for 12 sec.

Incinerate.desc: Deals 97 Fire damage to your target and an additional 25% damage if the target is afflicted by Immolate.

Master Demonologist.desc: Grants both the Warlock and the summoned demon an effect as long as that demon is active. Imp - Increases Fire damage done by 10%. Voidwalker - Reduces Physical damage taken by 10%. Succubus/Incubus - Increases Shadow damage done by 10%. Felhunter - Reduces Magic damage taken by 10%.

Nightfall.desc: Gives your Corruption, Drain Soul, Drain Life, and Wrack spells a 4% chance to cause you to enter a Shadow Trance after damaging the opponent. The Shadow Trance reduces the casting time of your next Shadow Bolt spell by 100%.

Pandemic.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Corruption, Bane of Agony, Bane of Doom, Drain Soul, Drain Life, Siphon Life, and Wrack spells by 100%.

Ruin.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Destruction spells by 100%.

Shadow and Flame.desc: Hitting an enemy with Conflagrate increases all Shadow damage you deal by 10% for 20 sec, and hitting an enemy with Shadowburn increases all Fire damage you deal by 10% for 20 sec. In addition, Conflagrate has a 100% chance not to consume Immolate, and Shadowburn has a 100% chance to instantly refund a Soul Shard.

Shadowburn.desc: Instantly blasts the target for 66 Shadow damage. If a non-trivial target dies within 8 sec of being hit with Shadowburn, the caster gains a Soul Shard.

Siphon Life.desc: Transfers 11 health from the target to the caster every 3 sec. Lasts 30 sec.

Soul Harvest.desc: Killing a non-trivial target afflicted by your Drain Soul increases your Mana regeneration by 100% for 10 sec and allows 100% of normal Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Soul Link.desc: When active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Demon instead. In addition, both the Demon and the master will inflict 3% more damage. Lasts as long as the Demon is active.

Soul Siphon.desc: Increases the damage done or health drained by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells by 12% per each of your other Affliction effects active on the target, up to a maximum increase of 36%.

Wrack.desc: Tears the target apart from within, dealing 36 Shadow damage every 1 sec and increasing the damage they take from your other Shadow damage over time effects by 10%. Lasts 6 sec.

Berserk.desc: $?a5487|a9634|a3025[Reuires Cat Form, Bear Form, Dire Bear Form][Requires Cat Form, Bear Form, Dire Bear Form] Causes your Primal Bite ability to strike up to 3 targets, removes its cooldown, and increases the critical strike chance of your Combo Point-generating abilities by 100%. Clears and grants immunity to Fear effects for the duration. Lasts 15 sec.

Eclipse.desc: Your Wrath spell reduces the cast time of your next 2 Starfire spells by 0.5 sec. Stores up to 4 charges. Lasts 15 sec.

Feral Charge.desc: $?a5487|a9634[Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form][Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form] Charge an enemy, immobilizing them and interrupting any spell they are casting for 4 sec. $@spelltooltip414924

Feral Swiftness.desc: Increases your movement speed while in Cat Form by 30%, and increases your chance to Dodge by 4%.

Gift of the Earthmother.desc: Reduces the global cooldown by 0.5 seconds on your Rejuvenation, Swiftmend, and Wild Growth spells.

Heart of the Wild.desc: Increases your Intellect by 10%. In addition, while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form your Stamina is increased by 20% and while in Cat Form your Strength is increased by 10%.

Improved Regrowth.desc: Increases the critical effect chance of your Regrowth spell by 50%.

Improved Starfire.desc: Reduces the cast time of Starfire by 0.5 sec and Starfire has a 15% chance to stun its target for 3 sec.

Improved Tranquility.desc: Reduces threat caused by Tranquility by 100% and its cooldown by 60%.

Insect Swarm.desc: The enemy target is swarmed by insects, decreasing their chance to hit with attacks by 2% and causing 48 Nature damage over 12 sec.

Leader of the Pack.desc: While in Cat Form, Bear Form, or Dire Bear Form, the Leader of the Pack increases the critical strike chance of all party members within 45 yards by 3%, exclusive with Moonkin Aura.

Moonglow.desc: Reduces the Mana cost of your damaging spells by 25%.

Moonkin Form.desc:
Transforms the Druid into Moonkin Form. While in this form, the armor contribution from items is increased by 360%, Omen of Clarity gains 100% increased chance to trigger, and all party members within 45 yards have their critical strike chance increased by 3%, exclusive with Leader of the Pack. The Moonkin cannot cast healing spells while shapeshifted.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

Natural Reaction.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 5%, and gives you a 100% chance to gain 5 Rage each time you dodge.

Nature's Grace.desc: All non-periodic spell criticals grace you with a blessing of nature, increasing your spellcasting speed and reducing your global cooldown by 10% for 3 sec.

Nature's Swiftness.desc: When activated, your next Nature spell becomes an instant cast spell.

Predatory Strikes.desc: Increases your melee Attack Power in Cat Form, Bear Form, and Dire Bear Form by 150% of your level.

Primal Bite.desc: Bite the target, dealing 100% normal damage plus 26 and generating a high amount of threat.

Reflection.desc: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Rend and Tear.desc: Increases damage done by your melee abilities on Bleeding targets by 10%.

Shifting Power.desc: Instantly convert ? Mana into 0 Energy. Shifting Power's cost is reduced by effects that reduce the cost of Shapeshifting.

Swiftmend.desc: Instantly heals a target with an active Rejuvenation or Regrowth effect for an amount equal to the full duration of the periodic effect of one of those spells.

Thick Hide.desc: While in Bear Form, Cat Form, Dire Bear Form, or Moonkin Form, you gain 3 additional base Armor per level and another 2 base Armor for each point of defense skill beyond five times your level. This amount can be further increased by multipliers from those forms.

Vengeance.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane and Nature spells by 100%.

Wild Growth.desc: Heals the target and their party for 336 over 7 sec. Party members must be within 43 yards of target. The amount healed is applied quickly at first, and slows down as Wild Growth reaches its full duration.
